name: Update Agent
description: Update a non-running agent's configuration and/or runtime state while preserving its history. Config accepts an inline map, a reference, or ordered layers; it is recursively merged over existing config with later values winning (vectors replace). State remains shallow-merged. Existing sessions keep their materialised prompt/tool prefix; use agent:reloadContext explicitly for an idle session that must adopt those changes. Agent configuration has one home: pass model, tools, caps, outputs, and systemPrompt under config; state.config is rejected. Framework-managed fields (status, tasks, inbox, timeline) are never affected. RUNNING is rejected because its active transition already captured the old config; suspend it before updating and resume afterward.

agentId.description: Agent reference: a bare name for the caller's agent, g/<id>, /g/<id>, or <ownerDID>/g/<id>

config.description: Config override layer(s): inline map, lattice/asset reference, or ordered array. Nested maps merge recursively over existing config; later scalar/vector/null field values replace earlier ones. Array entries must each be a map or string reference; null is not a layer.

state.description: State fields to merge (runtime data only). A 'config' key inside state is rejected (#144), as is a 'loads' key — loads live on the context scope chain: config.loads (operator pins) and per-session loads (#142).
